title: Warm Italian Sausage and Cannoli Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole that combines the flavors of Italy with the sweetness of cannoli.
instructions: Cook the Italian sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the cubed bread to the skillet and cook until lightly toasted.
In a separate bowl, combine the crushed cannoli, drained sauerkraut, and grated mozzarella.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the bread mixture in the bottom.
Top with the sausage mixture, followed by the remaining bread mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
